name: Cartier Love Bracelet
description: The bracelet you screw onto your wrist with a tiny screwdriver. The gift that means: this is serious. Yellow gold.

name: Vintage Rolex Datejust (1963)
description: Found at auction in Geneva. Honey patina. The kind of watch that says you understand restraint.

name: Van Cleef Vintage Alhambra Necklace
description: Mother-of-pearl in yellow gold. The classic. Says: I see you and I want everyone else to see I see you.

name: Tiffany Diamond Tennis Bracelet
description: Three carats of diamonds set in platinum. Discreet. Heavy on the wrist. Statement without speech.

name: Basquiat Limited Print (signed estate edition)
description: Edition of 85 from the estate. Framed by Hugo Guinness. The kind of gift that hangs.

name: Vija Celmins Lithograph
description: From her ocean series. The kind of work that makes you stand still in front of it. For someone who notices.

name: Commissioned Portrait by Hope Gangloff
description: She'll paint them. Six-month wait. The gift that becomes the thing in their living room forever.

name: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti 2015 (single bottle)
description: One bottle. The gift that says you understand what to drink and when.

name: Yamazaki 50 Year (single bottle)
description: One of fewer than 200 bottles ever made. For the whisky person who has everything.

name: Springbank 30 Year
description: Quietly the most respected whisky on earth among people who actually drink whisky.

name: Clase Azul Ultra Añejo
description: Tequila in a hand-painted ceramic decanter. The bottle alone is the art.

name: Hermès Birkin 30 (Etoupe)
description: The waitlist gift. Etoupe leather, palladium hardware. The classic.

name: Loro Piana Cashmere Travel Set
description: Cashmere blanket, eye mask, slippers. For long flights and short retreats. Quietly extravagant.

name: Maison Margiela Archive Coat (1998)
description: Sourced through a Tokyo dealer. Pristine. The kind of piece a fashion person actually weeps over.

name: Bespoke Anderson & Sheppard Suit Commission
description: Commissioned. Three fittings in London. The kind of gift that takes nine months and lasts thirty years.

name: Surprise Weekend Anywhere (your jet)
description: Pick a destination. Tell them to pack. Send the car. The gift is the gesture.

name: Booked Week at Their Favorite Aman
description: All on you. Pavilion suite. Their dates. The note says: you don't have to invite me.

name: Private Helicopter Charter Day
description: Wherever they are. Whatever they want to see from above. Pilot, champagne, flexible hours.

name: Private Three-Star Omakase Night
description: Closed counter. Twenty courses. Just them and whoever they bring.

name: Monthly Flowers from Mark Colle (one year)
description: Twelve months of his arrangements. Different city each month. The kind of subscription that makes them think of you when they walk into a room and stop.

name: Out-of-Season Peonies (overnighted)
description: Their favorite flower. Out of season. There anyway.

name: First Edition of Their Favorite Novel
description: Tracked down through a London dealer. Inscribed by a previous owner whose name they'll recognize.

name: Handwritten Letter (in your hand)
description: Three pages, your handwriting, sent priority mail. The gift that costs nothing and means most.

name: Hand-Curated Playlist (sent monthly, 1 year)
description: Twelve playlists. Twelve months. The gift that makes them think of you while driving.

name: Leica Q3
description: The camera people who already own cameras want. The kind of gift that gets used.

name: Restored 1965 Vespa GS (delivered)
description: Italian restoration shop. Mint green. Shipped to wherever they want it.

name: Puppy from Top Breeder (their breed)
description: Years on the waitlist. Suddenly available. The gift that becomes their whole world.

name: Naming Donation in Their Name (university chair)
description: Endowed chair at their alma mater. Plaque with their name. Permanent legacy.

name: Private Meditation Retreat in Bhutan
description: Two weeks. Senior monk. The gift for someone who needs to disappear.

name: Week with a Bologna Nonna (private)
description: Seven days in her kitchen. She teaches them everything she knows. They go home different.

name: Private Lesson with Koto Master (Kyoto)
description: Three hours with a living national treasure. They show you the instrument. You leave changed.

name: Cuban Cigar Collection (rare vintage)
description: Pre-embargo Cohibas. Acquired through Geneva. The cigar gift that means business.

name: Monogrammed Stationery from Smythson
description: Their initials. Bond Street paper. The gift that reminds them daily of correspondence.

name: Private Concert by Their Favorite Musician
description: They show up at your venue. Forty-minute set. Drinks after. Whatever scale they want.

name: Pure Arabian Horse (delivered to stables)
description: Pedigree mare from a Saudi breeder. Six-month vet quarantine handled.

name: Trained Hunting Falcon (UAE)
description: Saker falcon, fully trained. Comes with master falconer for handover.

name: Rare Orchid (from a private collection)
description: Lady's slipper variety. Only 50 known specimens. Living gift, requires care.

name: Day with a Private Art Curator (any city)
description: Galleries, studios, after-hours museum visits. The kind of day that opens doors.

name: Bespoke Perfume from Frédéric Malle
description: Three sessions in Paris. Custom scent that's only theirs. Reorderable in their name forever.

name: First-Press Vinyl Collection (their genre)
description: Rare originals tracked down through Tokyo and London dealers. The collection they always meant to start.

name: Hand-Carved Chess Set
description: Russian master craftsman. One of fewer than ten he'll make per year. Pieces feel impossibly weighted.

name: Anonymous Donation to Their Cause
description: Their foundation. No attribution. They find out by accident months later.

name: Week with Top Tennis Coach (private)
description: ATP-level coach flies to wherever they are. Five days. Court access included.

name: Aged Pu-erh Tea Collection (1980s)
description: Compressed tea bricks aged forty years. The kind of gift that requires explaining.

name: Bespoke Italian Leather Suitcase (Pineider)
description: Initials embossed. Made in Florence. The gift they take everywhere.

name: Vintage Hermès Scarf (1960s, framed)
description: Brides de Gala in original colorway. Framed by a Paris specialist.

name: Private Yacht Day Charter
description: 120-foot yacht for a day. Crew, chef, swim platform. Wherever they want.

name: Villa Week (Mediterranean)
description: Eight bedrooms. Staff. Their friends invited. The week that becomes a story.

name: Custom-Pressed Vinyl (their songs)
description: A record they helped make or that means something. Pressed in an edition of one. Sleeve designed.

name: Framed Photograph (a moment they don't remember being captured)
description: Caught them laughing somewhere. Printed properly. Framed. The kind of gift they keep.

name: Private Driver + Rolls (one month)
description: A car and a driver in their city for a month. The gift that disappears all the small frictions of life.

name: Session with Their Favorite Tattoo Artist
description: Booking the artist they've been on a 2-year waitlist for. You pay. They go.

name: Discontinued Perfume (their old favorite)
description: Tracked down a bottle of the perfume they wore in college. The gift that smells like memory.

name: Private Language Immersion Week
description: Native tutor, private villa, the language they always meant to learn. One week. Total immersion.
